newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel debt plan unaffected - Ponsolle.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel debt plan unaffected - Ponsolle.

text.p: Eurotunnel co-chairman Patrick Ponsolle said on Wednesday the tunnel fire would not affect a plan to restructure the company's debt.
Speaking at a news conference Ponsolle said "there is no reason for us to put into question the restructing."
Ponsolle said as the company expected to resume normal service in the coming months there would no reason to question the basis of the debt restructuring.
"This is the basic scenario we are working on with our bank creditors," Ponsolle said.

Ponsolle also said the company did not face any problems with cashflow. He said Eurotunnel had 100 million pounds ($167.7 million) in cash holdings and "it is not under financial pressure to reopen services".
"There is no reason to expect a cashflow crisis," he told the news conference.
